obfuscation_indicators: may cause actual results to differ materially
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and balanced, with meaningful quantification of enrollment, spending, tax exposure, leverage, and Medicare Advantage rate pressure. It contains standard forward-looking disclaimers and some broad, non-quantified language around competition, regulation, and future cost trends. Overall tone is cautiously confident, though funding pressure, regulatory changes, medical costs, and capital-market access remain material risks.
